name: Unitree H1
summary: H1 is Unitree's full-size bipedal humanoid, about 1.8 m tall and 47 kg. It is sold mainly to research and development customers. A later H1-2 variant adds more arm and leg joints and is heavier.

dof.original: 5 DoF per leg + 4 DoF per arm

compute: Intel Core i5 or i7 standard; H1-2 can add up to three NVIDIA Orin NX modules.
highlights: Battery capacity is 864 Wh and the pack is quickly replaceable.
At the August 2023 reveal, Unitree said the price was expected to be below $90,000.
The H1-2 variant is about 178 cm and 70 kg with 27 DoF and a rated arm payload of about 7 kg.
caveats: Unitree does not publish a list price; sales are quote-based.
The 3.3 m/s figure is the company's stated moving speed, not an independent measurement.
